schema.text: When you cycle, what do you do when the air is bad (exhaust fumes, dust, bad smells)?

options.text: I notice it, but I don't change anything
I protect myself, e.g. with a mask
I take another route or travel at another time
I travel another way (e.g. by bus instead of by bike)
